## [1.13.3](https://github.com/Akash-Sriram/morphe-google-photos/compare/v1.13.2...v1.13.3) (2026-10-04)

### 🐛 Bug Fixes

* **googlephotos:** remove toast popups from local creation downloader ([11b28bc](https://github.com/Akash-Sriram/morphe-google-photos/commit/11b28bc29143e30d69e9295e5f759b3f6ec450a0))
* **googlephotos:** save collages to DCIM/Google Photos and upgrade Fife URL quality ([2fa4468](https://github.com/Akash-Sriram/morphe-google-photos/commit/2fa4468732b202794070a6cbc51f2298088c8d4f))

### ✨ New Features

* **googlephotos:** add local creation downloader for quota-free memory collages ([b3db13b](https://github.com/Akash-Sriram/morphe-google-photos/commit/b3db13b6fa0c4c9bb15707e5e48e036df7c06586))
* **googlephotos:** hide save button when saved locally and prevent duplicate downloads ([6f81101](https://github.com/Akash-Sriram/morphe-google-photos/commit/6f8110154ae3f664ca110a433d8db55396039a5a))

patches.name: Account avatar
patches.description: Loads and displays account profile avatars across the top toolbar, Bento menu, and account switcher.

patches.name: AMOLED dark theme
patches.description: Makes Google Photos dark surfaces true black while keeping light mode untouched.

patches.name: Change to official package name
patches.description: Keeps the official package name (com.google.android.apps.photos) instead of renaming to app.morphe.android.apps.photos. Enable this only if Google Photos is uninstalled via ADB or installed as a system app with root. When selecting this, also select 'Disable Play Store updates'.

patches.name: Custom Morphe branding
patches.description: Replaces the Google Photos icon and in-app logos with Morphe branding (violet / teal / indigo / slate pinwheel, hand-drawn style).

patches.name: Disable Play Store updates
patches.description: [Experimental] Disables Play Store updates by setting the version code to the maximum allowed. This patch may cause unexpected issues with some apps and does not work if the app is installed by root mounting

patches.name: Enable DCIM folders backup control
patches.description: Disables always on backup for the Camera and other DCIM folders, allowing you to control backup for each folder individually. This will make the app default to having no folders backed up.

patches.name: Enable Phenotype flag manager
patches.description: Enables an in-app flag manager in Photos Settings to toggle curated experimental UI redesigns, video editor tools, and feature flags.

patches.name: Fix memory style font loading
patches.description: Redirects font loading across Stories and UI to authentic Google Fonts with local caching and CDN downloading, fixing fallback fonts and blank text in Memories.

patches.name: GmsCore support
patches.description: Allows the app to work without root by using a different package name when patched using a GmsCore instead of Google Play Services.

patches.name: Google One Bento Badge
patches.description: Restores the genuine Google One subscription badge in the Google Photos Bento account menu.

patches.name: Local creation downloader
patches.description: Intercepts saving memory collages and creations, exporting them to the device Google Photos folder (DCIM/Google Photos) for quota-free backup instead of direct cloud library commits.

patches.name: Model Readiness Gates
patches.description: Bypasses the 0MB Mobile Data Download check for AI models and reports them as loaded.

patches.name: Spoof features
patches.description: Spoofs the device to enable Google Pixel exclusive features, including unlimited storage.
